name: airtable_record_appender
description: Appends one or more records to an Airtable base through the Airtable Web API, batching around the 10-record request limit and returning the created record ids.

table.description: Table name or table id, e.g. Leads.

records.description: Records to append: a list of field mappings such as [{"Name": "Ada"}], or the wrapped [{"fields": {...}}] form.

token.description: Airtable personal access token; falls back to the AIRTABLE_API_KEY environment variable.

typecast.description: Let Airtable coerce values that do not match the field type.
